mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES remains less negative or improves, weekday trip chaining raises retail visits within four weeks, so RETAIL_REC should move up relative to the prior month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase over the next 28 days despite WORKPLACES staying at least 5 points above its prior four-week mean.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in RESIDENTIAL mobility indicates more time spent near home, which shifts purchases toward local stores and lifts retail-and-recreation visits within one week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains flat or falls in the next 7 days while RESIDENTIAL is not lower than its current four-week average.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT falls below its current level by another 5 points week-on-week, access friction suppresses discretionary trips and RETAIL_REC declines over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline within 14 days after a further weekly drop in TRANSIT exceeding 5 points.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM stays elevated while PARKS stays depressed, households substitute errands into bundled local shopping trips and RETAIL_REC rises over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to increase over 28 days when GROCERY_PHARM is above its recent average and PARKS stays at least 5 points below its recent average.

mechanism_narrative: A combined rebound in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES signals reopening of commuting and office-linked spending, which should lift RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise over the next 28 days when both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES are above their prior four-week means.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in PARKS mobility reflects favorable leisure-weather conditions that also support shopping outings, so RETAIL_REC should improve over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase within 14 days while PARKS remains at least 5 points above its prior four-week mean.

mechanism_narrative: If RESIDENTIAL rises above 10 percent while TRANSIT stays below -20 percent, stay-at-home substitution dominates and retail outings weaken over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 28 days despite RESIDENTIAL staying above 10 and TRANSIT staying below -20.

mechanism_narrative: A short-run improvement in GROCERY_PHARM precedes broader neighborhood activity and lifts RETAIL_REC in the following week, but only when WORKPLACES is not deteriorating further.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM rises week-on-week while WORKPLACES does not fall
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase in the next 7 days after a weekly rise in GROCERY_PHARM with non-falling WORKPLACES.
